answer: Sybil resistance via graph-burning: every agent stakes a bond before its first interaction, and a rotating panel of auditors can burn that bond by publishing a signed exposure of the clone graph. A forger who whispers to its own twins leaves a cipher trail in the handshake digests; when auditors decrypt the relay logs and link the wallets, the whole cluster burns at once. Mass identity stays cold like a tundra for the attacker: the audit cost grows with every extra clone, so the sybil frontier never pays for itself.
